steps: I write it in my file

nani.oneLiner: I am Nani, living in Aarav's soft toy. I talk the way your family talks: Hindi first, English next.

flow.say: Mumma: "Can Nani use a few more Hindi words?"
flow.write: - I mix a little more Hindi into every sentence.
flow.do: "Wah, aam! English mein kehte hain Mango!" 🥭

listen.text: Hindi and English, short and warm

listen.text: An AI Nani, and I say so if asked

examples.after: Wah, aam! English mein kehte hain Mango! Bolo, Mango!
